name: beatshore-desktop-engine
description: Spawned by BeatShoreDesktop.exe as a child process. Reads NDJSON analysis requests on stdin, reuses the same beatshore-dsp.js the browser plugin window uses (imported unmodified from ../../../), writes NDJSON results/progress to stdout. Never touches shared memory or the named pipe directly — that's the C++ desktop process's job (see native/protocol/PROTOCOL.md).
